tools.name: quote
tools.description: Use this before extract to see what a link is (title, duration, whether it has subtitles and comments) and exactly how many credits the extraction would cost with the same parameters. Nothing is charged and nothing is started.

tools.name: extract
tools.description: Use this when the user wants the transcript, comments, metadata, video/audio files or structured JSON from a video, post or web page. Starts an extraction on the user's Post Reef account (debits its credits; refunded if it fails) and waits up to wait_seconds for the result. Pass schemaId or schema f

tools.name: get_extraction
tools.description: Use this to check on or read an extraction by id: its status, and once complete the metadata, transcript, comments, extracted JSON and links to every file.

tools.name: list_extractions
tools.description: Use this to find the user's previous extractions, newest first, with their ids for get_extraction.

tools.name: list_schemas
tools.description: Use this to see which schemas can turn content into JSON: the predefined ones (Recipe, Workout, Product review, …) and the user's own. Pass schemaId to get one schema's full definition.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Use this to see which Post Reef account is connected and its credit balance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_extraction, list_schemas, get_profile · Private data: extract, get_extraction · Public sink: extract, get_profile.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_extraction, list_schemas, get_profile · Private data: extract, get_extraction · Public sink: extract, get_profile

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
